scope.purpose: Map BetterMakati against the current BetterGov civic-tech ecosystem before adding cross-portal UI or data dependencies.
sourceNotes: Current BetterGov projects page lists 17 projects.
BetterGov main-portal navigation also links ecosystem projects not present on the current projects page; those are marked linked rather than assigned an unverified live/development status.
BetterLGU is treated as the cross-LGU discovery and contributor-routing layer.

principles: BetterMakati owns the Makati-local experience and synthesis.
Official government sources remain the factual authority for transactions, requirements, legal rules and official records.
BetterGov ecosystem products may extend discovery, evidence, national context or structured data; they do not replace an official source where one exists.
BetterLGU is the cross-LGU escape hatch and contributor directory, not a national-service intermediary.
Prefer integration over duplication when a stable ecosystem capability already solves the national-scale problem.
Do not make core BetterMakati functions depend on an external ecosystem site being available.
Do not surface ecosystem architecture sermons in the UI; links should appear because they help complete the user's task.
For political records, use ecosystem sources only as neutral evidence or structured data and never create BetterMakati rankings, endorsements or inferred judgments.

ecosystemProjects.name: BetterGov.ph core portal
ecosystemProjects.notes: Use for national-service discovery, national government directories, government websites and travel/visa context. BetterMakati national service CTAs should still go directly to the issuing agency.

ecosystemProjects.name: BetterLGU Directory
ecosystemProjects.notes: Primary cross-LGU route for users who need another city or municipality and for contributors looking for an existing local portal.

ecosystemProjects.name: Transparency Portal
ecosystemProjects.notes: Use as national evidence context for procurement, public spending and other transparency records when a Makati record has a clear counterpart.

ecosystemProjects.name: Data Research / Visualizations
ecosystemProjects.notes: Use for national comparisons and existing research views; avoid rebuilding national visualizations locally.

ecosystemProjects.name: 2026 Budget Analysis
ecosystemProjects.notes: National budget context only. Makati city budget and fiscal records remain BetterMakati-owned.

ecosystemProjects.name: Open Data Portal
ecosystemProjects.notes: Highest-priority structured-data candidate. Audit dataset/API stability per use case before adding runtime dependencies and keep cached/local fallbacks.

ecosystemProjects.name: Flood Control Browser
ecosystemProjects.notes: Use when Makati records relate to DPWH or national flood-control projects. Do not duplicate the full national browser.

ecosystemProjects.name: The Cadena Act
ecosystemProjects.notes: No BetterMakati integration until the project has a stable public capability relevant to a Makati workflow.

ecosystemProjects.name: PhilGEPS procurement browser
ecosystemProjects.notes: Procurement handoff now uses the live BetterGov Transparency procurement browser. Prefer direct official PhilGEPS notice links only when the numeric PhilGEPS refid has been independently matched.

ecosystemProjects.name: Political Dynasty Tracker
ecosystemProjects.notes: Only use where a sourced factual relationship dataset directly supports a page. No BetterMakati evaluative labels, rankings or electoral conclusions.

ecosystemProjects.name: Open Congress API
ecosystemProjects.notes: High-value structured source for national legislative records affecting Makati. Preserve official legislative sources where available.

ecosystemProjects.name: Hotlines
ecosystemProjects.notes: Use as nationwide fallback after Makati-specific emergency and city contacts.

ecosystemProjects.name: Bisto.ph
ecosystemProjects.notes: Potential handoff for nationally funded infrastructure reporting. Do not auto-forward BetterMakati reports until interoperability and consent are explicitly designed.

ecosystemProjects.name: Tax Calculators / Tax Directory
ecosystemProjects.notes: Use for national tax calculators/reference; keep Makati local tax and permit guidance inside BetterMakati.

ecosystemProjects.name: SALN Tracker
ecosystemProjects.notes: Evidence reference only when a specific public record is relevant. Do not infer wealth, integrity, legality or fitness from SALN data.

ecosystemProjects.name: Price Guides
ecosystemProjects.notes: Potential national benchmark/context source. Audit data provenance and update cadence before consuming values directly.

ecosystemProjects.name: OpenGovChain
ecosystemProjects.notes: Do not create a dependency while the product is under active development.

ecosystemProjects.name: Petitions
ecosystemProjects.notes: Optional escalation path when a user wants to organize public support, distinct from reporting a service issue or submitting a BetterMakati correction.

ecosystemProjects.name: Philippines Quiz
ecosystemProjects.notes: No current BetterMakati task needs this capability.

ecosystemProjects.name: Budget Tracker
ecosystemProjects.notes: Potential historical/current national budget context. Verify scope and maintenance before making it a primary handoff because 2026 Budget Analysis already overlaps.

ecosystemProjects.name: Bantay PH
ecosystemProjects.notes: Defer until its stable public scope and a concrete BetterMakati user journey are verified.

ecosystemProjects.name: OpenBayan
ecosystemProjects.notes: Useful civic-tech discovery/contribution route, especially for users seeking projects beyond Makati.

ecosystemProjects.name: Juris
ecosystemProjects.notes: Useful legal research handoff for statutes and jurisprudence. Official laws, court issuances and agency rules remain preferred factual authority.

integrations.purpose: National-service directory/reference after direct official transaction paths.

Nationwide emergency/contact fallback for hotline queries.

Contribute to or start another local portal.

National agency/government website directory outside Makati-specific office context.
Procurement evidence by matched project/notice identifier.
Other national budget years after maintenance check.
